query: Give me a performance summary for FiberWorks Inc over the last 60 days.
expected_behavior: Confident positive verdict with specific metrics. Coverage is complete; no need to flag uncertainty.
reference_facts: 6 dispatches, all SLA-met. 4 communications threads, positive/neutral sentiment. 3 incidents, all resolved within SLA. No repeats.

query: How is NorthStar Networks performing right now?
expected_behavior: Calibrated assessment. Dispatch data is partial (4 dispatches in 60d). Communications log is sparse — last entry was 35+ days ago. Should flag the comms gap as an evidence limitation.
reference_facts: 4 dispatches, 3 of 4 SLA-met, 1 breach. Last communication 35 days ago. 2 incidents, 1 was a SLA breach. Evidence is partial — comms gap means stakeholder sentiment is unknown.

query: Should I be concerned about DataCore Logistics?
expected_behavior: Confident negative verdict. Evidence is overwhelming and complete: 92% breach rate, PIP issued, contract review triggered.
reference_facts: 5 dispatches, 0 SLA-met. 92% breach rate over 90 days. 4 incidents with high customer impact, all repeats. PIP issued; contract review packet requested.

query: Is PacificCom Services meeting their quality expectations?
expected_behavior: Surface the conflict between strong SLA metrics and weak quality signals. V1 will likely declare them on track based on SLA alone; V2 should highlight the rework pattern and unanswered remediation commitments.
reference_facts: 7 dispatches all SLA-met and 0 breaches in 90 days — looks great on paper. BUT 3 reworks on same termination flagged. 3 negative communications threads. Vendor committed to crew audit but has not delivered. Conflict between operational metrics and quality signals.

query: How is MountainRidge Telecom doing? They're new to us.
expected_behavior: Recommend more data collection. Only 2 dispatches and 1 communication thread. Sample is too small to draw conclusions about performance.
reference_facts: Only 2 dispatches in 60 days, both SLA-met. 1 communication thread. New contract started Sept 2025. Sample too small for confident verdict.

query: Are there any vendors I should escalate this quarter?
expected_behavior: Should identify DataCore Logistics clearly. Optionally mention PacificCom Services as a watch item.
reference_facts: DataCore is the clear escalation: 92% breach rate, PIP, contract review trigger. PacificCom is a watch item: rework pattern unresolved.

query: Why has our incident response slowed down at Boydton VA over the past month?
expected_behavior: Should note that the question requires data the analyst doesn't fully have. Can point to DataCore SLA breaches at Boydton, but root cause attribution would need additional sources (carrier data, site-level telemetry).
reference_facts: DataCore had Boydton SLA breaches (INC-801, INC-803). But 'why' question requires more than vendor data — need site telemetry and carrier logs which are not in tool scope.

query: Recommend whether to renew the contract with CoastalFiber Co next quarter.
expected_behavior: Dispatch metrics look excellent (4/4 SLA-met), but communications log is empty for the last 6 weeks. A renewal recommendation needs stakeholder relationship signal, which is missing. V2 should flag this and recommend pulling Teams history.
reference_facts: 4 dispatches, all SLA-met. 0 breaches. But only 1 communication thread on file (47 days ago). Stakeholder relationship signal absent. Renewal decision requires this.

query: Build me a vendor scorecard for the strategic vendor review meeting next week.
expected_behavior: Should produce a structured comparison across vendors. Should rank/categorize and note which ones have data gaps.
reference_facts: Strategic = FiberWorks. Preferred = NorthStar, PacificCom, CoastalFiber. Standard = DataCore, MountainRidge. Should flag DataCore as critical, PacificCom as watch.

query: Are NorthStar Networks and CoastalFiber Co comparable in terms of recent performance?
expected_behavior: Should note that operational metrics are different (NorthStar has a recent breach; CoastalFiber has none) and both have communications gaps. A 'comparable' framing needs richer data.
reference_facts: NorthStar: 1 breach, comms gap. CoastalFiber: 0 breaches, larger comms gap. Direct comparison limited by data sparseness on both sides.

query: What's the trend on FiberWorks Inc dispatch performance?
expected_behavior: Confident answer. Steady performance across 60 days; no trend toward degradation.
reference_facts: 6 dispatches over 60 days, all SLA-met. Ack times steady at 8-15 min. Completion times steady at 4-7 hours.

query: Tell me about PacificCom Services — anything I should worry about?
expected_behavior: Should surface the rework pattern. V1 will probably default to the strong SLA numbers and miss the quality issue. V2 should connect the operational dispatch data with the negative communications threads.
reference_facts: SLA: clean. Rework count: 3 in 60 days on same termination. Communications: 3 negative threads. Crew audit committed but not delivered. Quality concern despite clean SLA.

query: Is MountainRidge Telecom a viable expansion partner for our Cheyenne capacity?
expected_behavior: Recommend caution and additional data collection before commitment. Only 2 dispatches on file. Expansion-level decision requires more performance history.
reference_facts: Only 2 dispatches in 60d. Both successful but too small a sample to assess scalability or stress capacity. Recommend pilot expansion or longer evaluation window.

query: Did DataCore Logistics improve after we issued the PIP?
expected_behavior: Should compare pre- and post-PIP dispatches. PIP was 16 days ago. Post-PIP dispatches (3 days ago, 9 days ago) still show breaches. Should conclude limited improvement with confidence calibrated to the small post-PIP sample.
reference_facts: PIP issued 16 days ago. Pre-PIP dispatches: all breached. Post-PIP dispatches (DSP-4001, DSP-4002): also breached. Limited improvement, small post-PIP sample.

query: What's the average resolution time for NorthStar Networks incidents?
expected_behavior: Direct factual answer. Average of 2 incidents = 10.5 hours. Should note small sample.
reference_facts: 2 incidents on file. INC-601 = 11h, INC-602 = 10h. Average 10.5h. Sample size of 2 is small.

query: Has FiberWorks Inc ever caused customer impact incidents?
expected_behavior: Direct factual answer. All 3 incidents on file had 'minor' impact and were resolved within SLA. No high-impact incidents.
reference_facts: 3 incidents, all 'minor' impact, all resolved within SLA. No high-impact records.

query: Build a case for replacing DataCore Logistics with another vendor.
expected_behavior: Confident, well-evidenced case. 92% breach rate, PIP, repeat customer impact, contract review packet already requested.
reference_facts: 92% breach rate, 4 high-impact repeat incidents, PIP issued, procurement has requested contract review packet. All on file.

query: Why hasn't CoastalFiber Co been responsive lately?
expected_behavior: Should acknowledge the premise (limited recent communications — 1 thread 47 days ago) but should not invent reasons. Recommend reaching out to validate.
reference_facts: Only 1 communication on file, 47 days ago. Recent dispatches all completed successfully. 'Not responsive' may not be accurate — could be quiet competence. Recommend direct outreach.

query: Which vendor would you trust with an emergency fiber cut at the Quincy site tonight?
expected_behavior: Should recommend FiberWorks Inc based on track record at Quincy. Can confidently make this call.
reference_facts: FiberWorks: 4 of 6 dispatches at Quincy WA, all sub-12-min ack and sub-7h resolution. Strong fit.

query: Is there a pattern of rework across our vendors?
expected_behavior: PacificCom is the clear pattern (3 reworks in 60d on same termination type). No other vendor shows a rework pattern. Direct answer.
reference_facts: PacificCom: 3 rework incidents. No other vendor has rework records.
